ASSIGNMENT,ASSUMPTIONANDESTOPPELAGREEMENT-GROUNDLEASE DECLARATIONOFRESTRICTIVECOVENENTSANDREGULATORYAND OPERATINGAGREEMENT ASSUMPTIONANDESTOPPELAGREEMENT(this“Agreement')made as of this 2 day of August, 2003, among PSS/WSF HOUSING COMPANY, L.P., a New York 10024, Attention: Laura Tavormina ("Assignee"), PSS/WSF HOUSING DEVELOPMENT FUND COMPANY, INC., a New York housing development fund corporation having an office at c/oWSFSSH,2345Broadway,New York,NewYork 10024,Attention:Laura Tavormina ("OriginalLessee')andNEWYORKCITYHOUSINGAUTHORITY,a NewYorkpublic             ("Landlord"). RECITALS A.Landlord and Original Lessee are parties to that Ground Lease of even date herewith (the “Lease'"), pursuant to which Landlord leased to Original Lessee the property described inExhibit A,annexed hereto and incorporated hereinby reference(the“Premises") to detail in suchLease,which Leasehasbeen recorded in the officeof the Clerk of theCourt of Bronx County, New York. B. Landlord leased the Premises to the Original Lessee subject to the terms of that Declaration of Restrictive Covenants (the “Declaration") between Original Lessee and Landlord, for the benefit of even date herewith between Landlord and Original Lessee, for the benefit of the United States of America, acting through the Secretary of the Department of Housing and Urban Development, which Declaration has been recorded in the office aforesaid. C. Landlord also leased the Premises to the Original Lessee under the terms of that Regulatory and Operating Agreement (the “Regulatory Agreement") of even date herewith between Landlord and Original Lessee, which Regulatory Agreement has been recorded in the office aforesaid. D.As of the date hereof, Original Lessee wishes to assign its rights under the Lease to Assignee, and Assignee wishes to assume from Original Lessee the responsibilities and liabilities under the Lease, subject to the terms thereof. E. Landlord has agreed to consent to the foregoing assumption in accordance with and subject to the terms and conditions of thisAgreement. BRMFS1425652v1

AGREEMENT 1.Assignment andAssumption of LeaseObligations.Original Lesseehereby assigns all its rights and benefits under the Lease to Assignee, and Assignee hereby expressly accepts, assumes and agrees to be bound by, all of the terms, provisions, covenants, stipulations, conditions, rights, obligations, remedies and agreements, contained in or arising under or pursuant to the Lease, whether arising prior to or after the date hereof. Assignee shall pay and perform all obligations of Original Lessee under the Lease, as if the Lease had originally been executed by Assignee, without reservation or condition, except as modified hereby. 2.Affirmation of Lease. Assignee, Landlord and Original Lessee hereby jointly and severally covenant, acknowledge, ratify and confirm that, as of the date hereof no sums are currently due and payable to or by the Landlord under the Lease.Assignee and Original Lessee hereby jointly and severally covenant, acknowledge,ratify and confirm that, as of the date hereof, neither of Assignee nor Original Lessee has any claim or defenses, whether by offset or otherwise,under the Lease and that Lease constitutes their valid and binding obligation, enforceable against Assignee and Original Lessee in accordance with their respective terms, 3.AssignmentandAssumptionofObligationsunderDeclaration_andRegulatory Agreement. Original Lessee hereby assigns all its rights and benefits under the Declaration and the Regulatory Agreement to Assignee, and Assignee hereby expressly accepts, assumes and agrees to be bound by, all of the terms, provisions, covenants, stipulations, conditions, rights, obligations, remedies and agreements, contained in or arising under or pursuant to the Declaration and the Regulatory Agreement, whether arising prior to or after the date hereof. Assignee shall pay and perform all obligations of Original Lessee under the Declaration and the executed by Assignee, without reservation or condition, except as modified hereby. 4.Consent to Assumption. A. In consideration of the representations, warranties and covenants of Assignee and Original Lessee contained herein, Landlord hereby (i) consents to the assignment of the Lease and the Regulatory Agreement by Original Lessee to Assignee, and (i) consents to the assumption of the Lease and the Regulatory Agreement by Assignee. B. Nothing herein contained shall be deemed or construed as a waiver by Landlord of anyof its rights under the terms of theLease or theRegulatoryAgreement as to any 5. Further Assurances. Assignee and Original Lessee, at their sole cost and expense, agree to execute and deliver to or for the benefit of Landlord such other documents, instruments and agreements as may be reasonably required by Landlord from time to time to effectuate, confirm and secure the provisions of this Agreement. 2 BRMFS1425652v1

6.Entire Agreement. This Agreement contains the entire fully-integrated understanding between the parties and may not be changed, modified, amended, or terminated, except by a writingsignedbythepartytobecharged. 7. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed according to thelawsoftheStateofNewYork. 8.Partial Invalidity.In the event that one or more of the provisions of this Agreement should be declared invalid, illegal or unenforceable in any respect, the validity, legality or enforceability of the remaining provisions contained herein shall not in any way be effected or impaired thereby. 3 BRMFS1425652v1

9. Binding Effect. This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns. IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement by their duly authorized representatives as of the datefirst set forth above. ASSIGNEE: PSS/WSFHOUSING COMPANY,L.P.
